sql_templates.description: Identify missing data for stocks in recent report runs using left joins to check for data completeness.
sql_templates.template:
WITH recent_runs AS (
    SELECT run_id, run_ts, analysis_date, universe_size, stocks_analyzed, stocks_filtered
    FROM report.enhanced_runs
    WHERE run_ts >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '20 days'
), 
missing_data_check AS (
    SELECT ef.run_id, ef.symbol
    FROM report.enhanced_filtered_stocks ef
    LEFT JOIN report.enhanced_runs er ON ef.run_id = er.run_id
    WHERE er.run_id IS NULL
)
SELECT rr.run_id, rr.run_ts, rr.analysis_date, COUNT(md.symbol) AS missing_stocks
FROM recent_runs rr
LEFT JOIN missing_data_check md ON rr.run_id = md.run_id
GROUP BY rr.run_id, rr.run_ts, rr.analysis_date
ORDER BY rr.run_ts DESC;

validation_rules: Ensure that SQL queries only read data and follow approved join and date rules.
